title: Topo Discovery geographically registered shaded relief

registration.source_crs: EPSG:3857 XYZ tiles; analytical inverse/forward Web Mercator
registration.integration: SVG image x=0 y=0 width=890 height=1235, clip with original land shapes; no alpha/coastline/labels/boundaries in raster

data.name: Mapzen / Tilezen Terrain Tiles hosted on AWS Open Data
data.sources_per_provider_documentation: At zoom 7/8: SRTM land (GMTED2010 fallback), ETOPO1 ocean. Not EU-DEM zoom 9.
data.license: Underlying SRTM, GMTED2010 and ETOPO1 are US government open/public-domain data; see provider attribution document for notices and limitations. No navigation warranty.
data.attribution: Mapzen Terrain Tiles. SRTM and GMTED2010 terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey. Global ETOPO1 terrain data: U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.
data.attribution_display: Include the attribution above in the app credits/data sources; this metadata alone is not a visible map credit.

pipeline.resampling: Decode to metre DEM before bilinear source pixel-centre sampling; seamless mosaic, no per-tile shade seams.

hillshade.gradient_spacing: latitude-aware metres on spherical earth R=6371008.8m

pipeline.texture: Only actual elevation residual from radius-3px low-pass; no noise, hand-drawn/invented strokes, or external imagery.
pipeline.smoothing: 0.55 SVG px Gaussian and 3 SVG px texture low-pass, scaled by DPR; bathymetry clamped to 0m before styling; raw source DEM retained for checks
pipeline.reproduce: python3 -m pip install numpy==1.24.4 Pillow==10.4.0 && python3 scripts/geography/generate-terrain.py --cache /path/to/scratch/terrain --zoom 8 --dpr 2
